admission.justification: Spans memory_quality/dependent_flags.py, converted_check.py, check.py, and the three OM-6 review-instruction files, and is guarded by lift, Lever-1 flag, and DPD-GHEXS9 replay tests.

applicability: Task-scoped memory_quality_check runs and independent memory reviews on converted memory.
conditions: All four dependent_flags findings (pre_base_stale_confirmation, deferral_lifted, deferral_orphaned, deferral_due_warning) emit strictly through reportOnlyFindings without affecting ok or findingCount.
pre_base_stale_confirmation lists the links that moved before the leaf base whenever an already-stale dependent is confirmed without editing its document.
Memory review under OM-6 requires a signed whole-document verdict plus base and candidate staleOnly=true receipts for every flagged confirmation and lifted deferral.
exclusions: The staleness computation itself (dependent_movement), which is unchanged.
Non-task unscoped quality runs without dependent_scope.
statement: memory_quality_check flags every confirmation of a document already stale at the leaf base and untouched by the leaf (with its pre-base moved links), every lifted deferral, and every orphaned or pre-base-changed deferral through reportOnlyFindings without affecting ok, and memory review instructions require a signed whole-document verdict with base and candidate staleOnly receipts.
title: MQC flags pre-base stale confirmations and lifts for signed OM-6 review
